content:
leah: Heads up — our scheduled batch GPU deploy is failing in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Lots of instance create errors; logs show 429s from the security-group API when creating transient SGs. Anyone else seeing this?
ops-bot: deploy-monitor: rollout 2026-03-18T15:10Z: 37/120 failed. Error: API rate limit (SecurityGroup): 429 TooManyRequests.
sam: yep, noticed. Onboarding script creates ~5 SGs per job, and we queued ~300 jobs across accounts. We basically flooded the SG create endpoint.
cheng: cloud provider enforces per-account SG creation QPS and rule attach QPS; looks like we hit both create and attach limits across regions. Also ENI attach limits might be tripping.
maria: quick mitigation idea — switch to pre-created, shared SG templates per-region (one per tenant-class) instead of creating per-job. We can patch infra in ~2h.
leah: @cloud-accounts can you open quota tickets for: 1) security-group creation rate, 2) ENI attach rate, 3) EC2 GPU instance quota for p4d and a100 families in both regions? Need ETA.
cloud-accounts: Filed ticket #123456789 with provider — requested SG create-rate bump to 100/sec and ENI attach bump to 500/min for us-west-2 + eu-west-1. Also requested GPU quota increases: p4d -> 40, a100 -> 60 per-region. Submitted logs & justification. ETA 48–72h but asked for expedited review.
cheng: short-term: add jitter + exponential backoff and cap parallel onboarding to 8 jobs/account. I'll push a small change to the onboarding worker in the next deploy. Patch diff (conceptual):
```
- parallel_jobs = 32
+ parallel_jobs = min(8, configured_parallel)
+ backoff = exponential(initial=200ms, factor=2, jitter=true)
```
sam: we'll also queue failed jobs into a retry/backfill flow with 30m delay. I'll kick off a backfill once the patch is live.
maria: cost/security note: pre-created SGs will reduce API churn but increase sharing surface — requires a short security review and lifecycle policy. :thinking:
ira: security OK for emergency mitigation if SGs are tagged per-customer and we attach strict egress/ingress templates + TTL-based lifecycle policy. Approve for emergency rollback-only change.
leah: action items: @cheng deploy backoff + parallelism cap; @cloud-accounts follow quota ticket and ask for expedited handling; @sam prepare backfill job; I'll update the incident doc and notify customers impacted by onboarding delays. Thanks. :thumbsup:
cloud-accounts: Update — provider approved SG rate bump in us-west-2 within ~6h and applied limits. ENI quota still pending; provider requested additional usage logs. I've uploaded extra traces.
ops-bot: deploy-monitor: rollout 2026-03-18T18:22Z: 118/120 succeeded. Remaining 2 in retry queue.
leah: closing loop: keep retrying queued jobs at low parallelism until ENI quota update. We'll revisit whether to permanently switch to shared SGs vs improving orchestration later.
